en_before: E-Girl is a later internet aesthetic shaped more by TikTok, Instagram, and gaming communities than MySpace. It can borrow from Scene, Emo, and Punk through graphic tees, plaid skirts, striped layers, chokers, chains, and colorful hair. Makeup, cropped silhouettes, and combinations of influences often vary more freely.
